title: Arnold DePass's band and sitting in at a benefit dance
summary: He plays with his wife's uncle Arnold DePass, then sits in at Sam Morgan's benefit dance where Kid Rena hears him.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: So, well, after, after I left that band, then I started playing with my wife's uncle. His name was, uh, Onall the Pass. Oh, yes. You heard him? Drummer. Yeah, that's right. Never knew him, but I've heard of him. Well, he had, his band was called, he called his band Olympia Band. You see? I played with him just about four months. And one night I went over to a place called, I think they call it the E-Light at that time, it was a cabaret. They used to call them cabaret or cabaret, something like that. Is that one on Ramparm Street? No, this was on, uh, on, uh, Iberville between, uh, Bugunda and Ramport. Yeah. Right along, almost where the, the post office is right now. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Well, I happened to go over there that night, Sam Morgan had a benefit dance over there. And I went in there. And they had different bands would come in and fellas would come in and play, this is like what you call jam sessions. And I don't know. Any musician in the place, they would ask me to sit in and play a few now. But the fellas didn't know me too good, especially those fellas that were in there, like Sam Morgan, and Joe Renner and, and, uh, a few others I could name. Well, the ones, the, the, the few that knew me, well, they'd ask me to play. They'd say, come on, you, you're the only one that haven't played anything. I said, come on and play. Well, I went and played and there was, uh, a boy, uh, that was playing at that time, his, uh, the banjo there, his name was Thomas. Everybody called him Son Thomas. Oh yes, I've heard of him. So Son said to me, say, come on and, come on and play, rest me up, man. So I said, on and up. Yeah. So Joe Renner was playing drama at the time. Kid Renner, right? Yes, yes.
